history.summary: Tenet is an executive condo in Tampines North (TOP 2026), 4BR 1,098 sqft at $1,800,000 / $1,639 psf, 470m from the future CR6 Tampines North MRT (CRL ~2030). EC pricing plus a within-500m future-MRT catalyst at the deep-pool $1.8M quantum make this the strongest 4BR in the batch.
history.rating_rationale: Tenet is an EC — entry pricing below private comparables, and ECs structurally re-rate on privatization (10yr). $1,639 psf is reasonable; $1.8M quantum sits right in the liquid sweet spot. 470m from CR6 Tampines North (Cross Island Line ~2030) is the single best uplift catalyst in this batch. Tampines Regional Centre adds demand depth. Highest Elo (1289) and record in the batch. Efficient 1,098 sqft 4BR. Main caveat is no URA series yet (new TOP).
red_flags: No URA transaction history yet (new TOP 2026) — appreciation modeled, not observed
EC resale restricted by MOP until ~2031 for some buyers; check eligibility/timeline
CRL operational date (~2030) is a multi-year wait for the catalyst to land
catalysts: 470m to future CR6 Tampines North MRT (Cross Island Line ~2030) — within the 500m strong-uplift band
Tampines Regional Centre + Tampines North growth area
$1.8M quantum in the deepest buyer band; efficient 4BR layout
